messages:
jess: Quick thought — can we build small embeddable cards for per-route insights? Like a 300x200 card teams can drop into docs or dashboards.
omar: :thumbsup: love it. Do you mean lightweight iframe with read-only data + filters pinned per-route?
lina: iframe or JS snippet. Need token scoping + CORS. Also decide which charts: p95 latency, avg tokens, error rate, request volume.
ryan: From telemetry side we can expose an aggregation endpoint: `/api/internal/embeds/route/:route_id?metrics=latency,errors&period=7d` — returns pre-aggregated buckets.
marta: Also want to support saved-query presets. Users pick a saved query and embed the view. Access control: shareable link vs org-only.
jess: UX Qs — embed builder in Console? Or a "Copy embed snippet" action on the route inspector?
omar: Prefer builder modal in the route inspector. Backend needs to generate short-lived signed token or allow public view flag.
lina: Frontend work: small responsive card component + loader + error state. If embed loads heavy data, show aggregated values only (no full timeline unless requested).
ryan: Telemetry: add an event when someone creates an embed (embed.created) and track impressions (embed.view). Also enforce a quota for embed API to avoid scraping.
omar: Quota note — embed endpoints should count toward read quota but at lower weight. Rate-limit by IP and also by route_id.
jess: Security — default embeds = org-only. Public embeds require an admin opt-in / allowlist. Also expose revoke UI for tokens.
marta: Can we support "export snapshot" too? One-click PNG/CSV for the current view (same builder modal). Useful for reports.
lina: PNG can be generated client-side via canvas or server-side render for higher fidelity. CSV via server export job; must respect saved query filters and time window.
omar: Implementation plan (rough): 1) aggregation telemetry + embed API 2) token service + token revocation 3) builder modal + snippet UI 4) admin allowlist + org settings 5) export endpoints.
product-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/embeds -> staging at 2025-06-04T02:00:00Z
jess: Timeline OK? target beta in 3 sprints. I'll draft UX mocks and a short spec.
omar: I'll break backend work into stories and add to eng-platform sprint. Need to confirm retention policy for embed metrics.
lina: I'll prototype the component this week and post screenshots in #design.
jess: Snippet idea for copy/paste:

```
<iframe src=\"https://console.redwood.ai/embed/route/abc123?token=__TOKEN__&metrics=p95,errors\" width=\"320\" height=\"220\" frameborder=\"0\"></iframe>
```

ryan: Recommend supporting a `?theme=light|dark` param and `referrer` header for attribution. Also add a small heartbeat ping to count views.
jess: OK — we'll include theme and minimal attribution metadata. Meeting after standup to lock API signatures.
omar: noted. I'll add initial API contract to the eng-platform board.
jess: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the spec and mock links.
